S.FORM: alang Namisan ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Buri go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 76 buwan, 187 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 47% kyan ku 87 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 53% kyan ku 100 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 46%, Paywan 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Namisan hya' ga rgyax. tay 'zil na Namisan hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Namisan hya' ga rgyax. tay mkraya' na Namisan hya' ga rgyax. tay mkraya' na Namisan hya' ga Afih. tay mkyahu' na Namisan hya' ga Angcoh. tay 'zil na Namisan hya' ga Cinemnemay. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Namisan ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Namisan ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ nami[s|ɕ]an ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu βuri ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** pajwan * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj ʔzil na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkrajaʔ na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkrajaʔ na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa a*iħ taj mkjaħuʔ na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa aŋ[ʦ|ʨ]oħ taj ʔzil na nami[s|ɕ]an ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]inemnemaj reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ nami[s|ɕ]an ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ nami[s|ɕ]an ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
